title: Application
text: Presence-Absence Matrix (PAM) fundamental data structure macroecological research represents species distributions discrete spatial framework. essence, PAM two-dimensional matrix : Rows represent discrete spatial units (grid cells) covering geographic domain Columns represent species Values binary: 1 indicates presence, 0 indicates absence first two columns typically store longitude (x) latitude (y) coordinates grid cell’s centroid, allowing matrix spatially referenced. text: 4 stages VasGBIF. export, approximately 30% initial occurrence records retained high-quality, non-redundant data. VasGBIF provides reproducible, tracheophyte-optimized, computationally efficient framework transforming GBIF records analysis-ready datasets. package functions organized 4 stages built around 7 core functions. Stage 1: Import Taxonomic Standardisation stage loads raw GBIF data resolves taxonomic names ensure consistency downstream processing. Import Records (import_records): Reads GBIF occurrence download ZIP, extracts occurrence table, parses GBIF issue flags record-level logical indicators. records filtered stage — diagnostic flags preserved later quality scoring. Check Taxon Name (check_taxon): Submits species- infraspecific-rank names Taxonomic Name Resolution Service (TNRS; Boyle et al. 2013) resolution World Checklist Vascular Plants (WCVP). Synonyms resolved accepted names; names matched retained flagged "found" manual review. Names species rank submitted receive NA WCVP fields. Stage 2: Duplicate Detection via Collection-Event Keys stage groups records potential collection events selects best representative group. Generate Collection-Event Keys (get_collections): Builds composite key record accepted WCVP taxon name, collection date (numeric), rounded geographic coordinates. key form wcvp_taxon_name|eventDate|latitude|longitude. Rounding precision user-controlled (default 2 decimal places ≈ 1 km), allowing user define spatial tolerance counts collection event. Records sharing complete key treated potential duplicates; records whose key missing component treated independent samples. Select Digital Vouchers (set_vouchers): Within duplicate group, records scored two quality dimensions: metadata completeness (9 fields: recordedBy, recordNumber, year, institutionCode, catalogNumber, locality, stateProvince, countryCode, identifiedBy, contributing 0–1 point) geospatial quality (penalty scale 0, −1, −3, −9 derived GBIF issue severity). highest-scoring record group designated master digital voucher validated coordinates propagated group members. frequent accepted taxon name group assigned consensus identification. Stage 3: Coordinate Validation Native-Status Annotation stage validates coordinates digital vouchers, restores missing metadata, annotates record native-range status. Refine Records (refine_records): Restores missing metadata fields (eventDate, year, month, day, identifiedBy, countryCode, stateProvince, locality) duplicate records sharing collection key via restore_duplicates. Validates coordinates CoordinateCleaner (Zizka et al. 2019) flag spatial errors centroids, capitals, marine coordinates, zero coordinates. Matches validated coordinates WGSRPD Level 3 areas WCVP distribution data via detect_native_status classify record native, introduced, extinct, location_doubtful, unknown. Coordinate validation parallelized across user-specified threads speed. Stage 4: Export Visualization Export Records (export_records): Writes refined records disk three gzip-compressed CSV files: usable records, native subset, records failed coordinate validation. Map Records (map_records): Renders refined records interactive map via mapview, geohash-based decluttering reduce visual overlap. Records colour-coded native status, multiple basemap layers supported (OpenStreetMap, Esri World Imagery, others). Focused exclusively GBIF plant occurrence records, VasGBIF can compile one million records within 15 minutes laptop without high memory usage. Anyway, VasGBIF integrates components unified, automated workflow enhances data standardization, accuracy, usability, enables robust, reproducible, scalable compiling GBIF tracheophyte records advanced biodiversity research.

title: Detect native status from WGSRPD distributions — detect_native_status
text: Assigns native status classification occurrence record matching validated coordinates WCVP distribution data via WGSRPD Level 3 polygons. Native status determined two stages, working one taxon time. Stage 1 — classify WGSRPD areas. internal Distributions dataset links WGSRPD Level 3 area code WCVP flags (introduced, extinct, location_doubtful). flags resolved single status label following priority: location_doubtful == 1, area classified "location_doubtful" regardless flags. Otherwise, introduced == 1, area "introduced". Otherwise, extinct == 1, area "extinct". three flags 0, area "native". remaining case defaults "unknown". Stage 2 — spatial intersection. taxon, validated occurrence points overlaid WGSRPD Level 3 polygon map (via terra::extract()) assign area code record. area code looked classified distribution table.
